POWER: Search your Banished Zone for a Named
card and place it on top of your Life Deck. Search
your Life Deck for a Named attack card and place

it into your hand. Your opponent may discard a

card from his hand to search his Life Deck for

a Named attack card and place it
into his hand.
(Banish after use.)
